info.title: Amana Backend API
info.description:
OpenAPI coverage for the live Amana backend routes under `backend/src/routes`.

Authentication flow:
1. Call `POST /auth/challenge` with a Stellar public key.
2. Sign the returned challenge with the wallet.
3. Exchange the signature at `POST /auth/verify` for an HttpOnly session cookie.
4. Send requests with credentials so the browser includes the cookie automatically.

JWT semantics enforced by middleware:
- `iss` must match `JWT_ISSUER` (default `amana`)
- `aud` must match `JWT_AUDIENCE` (default `amana-api`)
- `jti` is required and checked against the revocation denylist
- `nbf` must be present and not be in the future

Error code references in operation descriptions map to backend `ErrorCode` values in
`backend/src/errors/errorCodes.ts`. Some route handlers still emit legacy `{ error }`
payloads while centralized validation/runtime failures return `{ code, message, details }`.

TradeIdPath.description: Trade identifier used by the backend route layer.

UserAddressPath.description: Stellar public key for the user profile being requested.

EvidenceCidPath.description: IPFS CID for the stored evidence object.

HistorySignedQuery.description: When true, include canonical payload and integrity metadata.

ListTradesStatusQuery.description: Exact `TradeStatus` value; any other value is rejected with 400.

TradeExportLimitQuery.name: limit
TradeExportLimitQuery.description: Page size for the JSON export. Ignored when `format=csv`.

IncludeInactiveCategoriesQuery.name: includeInactive
IncludeInactiveCategoriesQuery.description: Include inactive dispute categories in the response.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Optional idempotency key cached for mutation requests for up to 24 hours.

signedChallenge.description: Base64url wallet signature for the issued challenge.

authenticated.description: Confirms that the HttpOnly access and refresh cookies were issued.

TradeExportRow.description:
Flattened trade row shared by the JSON and CSV exports. `fee` is always
an empty string because platform fees are not yet persisted per trade.

removed.description: False when the trade was not on the caller's watchlist.

WatchedTrade.description: Full trade row returned by the watchlist with the bookmark timestamp.

watchedAt.description: When the caller bookmarked the trade.

amountUsdc.description: USDC amount, at most 7 decimal places, no negative sign.

dueAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp for the milestone due date.

nextReleaseDate.description: Earliest unreleased milestone due date in the future, or null.

ManifestView.description:
Returned shape depends on caller role.
- Seller views include full manifest fields.
- Buyer views mask driver identity fields.
- Mediator/admin views expose hashed identity values.

UnauthorizedError.description:
Missing, invalid, revoked, or semantically invalid session. `authMiddleware`
returns the classified error as `{ code, error, details }`; `details.errorType`
is one of `missing_header`, `invalid_format`, `invalid_token`, `expired_token`,
`network_error`, `config_error`.

ForbiddenError.description: Authenticated caller is not allowed to perform the action.

post.description:
Withdraws tokens from the escrow contract treasury. Only wallets in the
`ADMIN_STELLAR_PUBKEYS` / mediator allowlist may call it; every other
authenticated caller receives 403.

The withdrawal itself is not implemented yet: `TreasuryService.withdraw`
throws a not-implemented `AppError` and the controller maps any non-403
failure to `500` with `{ "error": "Treasury withdrawal failed" }`, so the
200 response below is currently unreachable.
Error code references: `AUTH_ERROR`, `DOMAIN_ERROR`, `INFRA_ERROR`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`.

destination.description: Stellar Ed25519 public key to receive the funds.

amount.description: Amount to withdraw in USDC. The handler only checks that it is a string.

400.description: Destination missing/not a string, not a valid Ed25519 public key, or amount missing/not a string.

403.description: Caller is not in the treasury admin allowlist.

get.description:
Exports every trade where the caller is the buyer or seller, optionally filtered
by status and creation date. `format=json` (default) returns one page plus
pagination metadata; `format=csv` returns the complete filtered set as a
UTF-8 BOM-prefixed `text/csv` attachment with the `TradeExportRow` columns in
declaration order and ignores `page`/`limit`.
`from`/`to` are aliases of `dateFrom`/`dateTo`; when both are supplied the
explicit `from`/`to` pair wins.
Error code references: `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `AUTH_ERROR`, `INFRA_ERROR`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Only trades created at or after this ISO-8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Only trades created at or before this ISO-8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Alias of `dateFrom`, used when `dateFrom` is absent.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Alias of `dateTo`, used when `dateTo` is absent.

200.description: JSON export page or CSV file.

400.description: Invalid query (for example `from` after `to`, or `limit` above 100).

example.error: from: from must be before or equal to to

get.description:
Lists trades the authenticated user has added to their watchlist, newest
bookmark first, with pagination metadata. Only trades the caller is a party
to can be watched in the first place.
Error code references: `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `AUTH_ERROR`, `INFRA_ERROR`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`.

post.description:
Adds a trade to the caller's watchlist. The trade must exist and the caller
must be its buyer or seller. Adding the same trade twice is idempotent and
returns the existing bookmark.
Error code references: `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `AUTH_ERROR`, `NOT_FOUND`, `FORBIDDEN`.

delete.description:
Removes a trade from the caller's watchlist. Ownership of the trade is checked
even when no bookmark exists, so this endpoint cannot be used to probe
unrelated trades. `removed` is false when the trade was not watched.
Error code references: `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `AUTH_ERROR`, `NOT_FOUND`, `FORBIDDEN`.

get.description: Lists notes for a trade visible to the authenticated user.

post.description: Adds a private note to a trade visible to the authenticated user.

get.description:
Returns the milestone-based release schedule for a trade, ordered by
`milestoneIndex`. A trade with no schedule returns `milestoneCount: 0`, an
empty `milestones` array, and `nextReleaseDate: null`. Accepts either the
`tradeId` string or the numeric surrogate key in the `id` path segment.
Error code references: `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `AUTH_ERROR`, `NOT_FOUND`, `INFRA_ERROR`.

post.description:
Replaces the trade's milestone-based release schedule. Existing milestones for
the trade are deleted before the new ones are written, so the call is a full
overwrite rather than an append. Only the buyer or seller may set the
schedule, and only while the trade is `CREATED` or `FUNDED`.
Error code references: `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `AUTH_ERROR`, `NOT_FOUND`, `FORBIDDEN`, `DOMAIN_ERROR`, `INFRA_ERROR`.

400.description:
Body failed validation (missing/empty `milestones`, more than 100 milestones,
negative `milestoneIndex`, malformed `amountUsdc`/`dueAt`) or the trade is
not in `CREATED`/`FUNDED` state.

value.error: Trade must be CREATED or FUNDED to set a release schedule (current: COMPLETED)

get.description:
Returns savings-goal analytics for the authenticated wallet, correlating each
goal with its vault balance. Amounts are returned as strings to preserve
precision; `percentageComplete` and `overallProgressPercentage` are
integer-truncated percentages, and `daysRemaining` is clamped to 0 once the
deadline has passed.
A wallet with no `User` row yields 404 (`NOT_FOUND`).
Error code references: `AUTH_ERROR`, `NOT_FOUND`, `INFRA_ERROR`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`.

404.description: No user record exists for the authenticated wallet.

post.description:
Browser-reported CSP violation collector wired to helmet's `report-uri`
directive. Unauthenticated, always responds `204 No Content`; violations are
logged and counted for metrics. Accepts `application/csp-report` (what browsers
send) or `application/json`, up to 20 KB. Rate limited to 10 reports per minute
per client.
Unlike the rest of the API this route is only mounted under the versioned
`/api/v1` prefix and has no legacy unprefixed alias.

413.description: Report body exceeded the 20 KB limit.

429.description: More than 10 reports in the last minute from the same client.
